8: Unless people hold on to the feet of the kind God, who is like an ocean of goodness, it is hard to swim across the other ocean, the vast sea of worldly life.
44: If a family fears doing anything shameful and shares its food with others, its family line will never die out.
48: A family life that helps others stay on the right path, and never turns away from what is right itself, is stronger than the strict self-discipline of people who give up home life.
56: A true wife guards herself, looks after her husband, protects the family’s good name, and never grows careless in any of these.
64: Plain porridge that your own children have stirred with their small hands tastes far sweeter than amrita (the drink of the gods).
71: Is there any lock that can keep love hidden? When someone dear is suffering, the tears of sorrow of those who love them will give it away.
74: Love makes us eager to be close to others. That eagerness brings friendship, a great treasure that comes to us without our looking for it.
76: Only people who do not understand say that love helps only in doing good. Love also gives strength for brave action against wrong.
81: People live a family life and save what they have for one main reason: to welcome guests and help others.
91: Truly sweet words come from people who have understood the truth. They are full of warm love and have no trickery in them.
123: If a person learns what is worth knowing and controls themselves in the right way, good people will notice, and it will bring them respect.
